{"content": "Title: Fresh Ideas Tracker

Purpose:
This document serves as a central repository for capturing and tracking innovative concepts and initiatives.

Structure:
1. Idea ID - Unique identifier.
2. Title - Short descriptive name.
3. Description - Brief overview.
4. Owner - Person responsible.
5. Status - e.g., Draft, In Review, Approved, Implemented.
6. Priority - 1-5 scale.
7. Notes - Additional remarks.

Instructions:
- Add a new entry whenever a fresh idea emerges.
- Update status and notes as progress occurs.
- Review weekly during team meetings.

Thank you for contributing!", "file_name": "FreshIdeas.txt"}
